readmeHtml:
The Data Engineering Handbook

This repo has all the resources you need to become an amazing data engineer!

Join the free Databricks AI boot camp on August 3rd here and signup for Databricks Free Edition here

Getting started

If you are new to data engineering, start by following this 2024 breaking into data engineering roadmap

If you are here for the 4-week free beginner boot camp you can check out:

  • introduction
  • software needed

If you are here for the 6-week free intermediate boot camp you can check out

  • introduction
  • software needed

For more applied learning:

  • Check out the projects section for more hands-on examples!
  • Check out the interviews section for more advice on how to pass data engineering interviews!
  • Check out the books section for a list of high quality data engineering books
  • Check out the communities section for a list of high quality data engineering communities to join
  • Check out the newsletter section to learn via email

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive roadmap and resource repository for learning data engineering.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: The Data Engineering Handbook provides a curated collection of resources, roadmaps, and guides for individuals looking to break into or advance in data engineering. It includes learning paths for 2024, links to beginner boot camps, and foundational knowledge. The repository structures learning materials to help users understand core data engineering concepts and tools. It acts as a centralized study guide and community resource.
keyFeatures: Learning roadmap: Offers a structured 2024 path detailing the essential skills needed to break into data engineering.
Boot camp resources: Links to organized beginner boot camps, such as a 4-week introductory program.
Tooling guides: Provides instructions and sign-up links for essential data platforms like Databricks Free Edition.
Curated resources: Aggregates tutorials, articles, and community links for comprehensive learning.
Community integration: Connects learners with community events and structured learning cohorts.

useCases.title: Beginner learning path
useCases.description: Aspiring data engineers who need a structured, step-by-step roadmap to learn the discipline from scratch.

useCases.title: Boot camp participation
useCases.description: Students participating in free beginner boot camps who need access to the course materials and setup instructions.

useCases.title: Skill upgrading
useCases.description: Existing developers or analysts looking to transition into data engineering by learning modern tools and practices.

useCases.title: Reference guide
useCases.description: Practitioners seeking a centralized index of data engineering resources and tool configurations.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This handbook is for beginners, students, and professionals aiming to learn or transition into data engineering. It assumes a basic interest in data, but provides introductory roadmaps for those starting from scratch.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Start by following the 2024 breaking into data engineering roadmap linked in the README.
